items.q: It is 9 pm. Your manager messages on WhatsApp asking for the sales report by 10 am tomorrow. You know it will realistically take until noon. What do you do?
o: Reply now: "I can send the key numbers by 10 and the full report by 12. Does that work, or is there one section you need first?"
Stay up late and finish it by 10 without mentioning the time it took
Reply first thing in the morning to say it will be ready by noon
Reply "Sure, no problem" and send it at noon

items.q: A client emails angrily because their order is three days late. The delay was the courier's fault. Which reply is best?
o: Apologise, give the new delivery date and what you have done to fix it, and offer a goodwill gesture if your policy allows
Apologise sincerely and promise it will not happen again
Explain politely that the courier caused the delay and it was outside your control
Forward it to your manager because the client is upset

items.q: You are presenting to senior managers. One interrupts with a question you planned to answer on slide 8 of 10. What do you do?
o: Answer it in one or two sentences now, then say you will show the detail on slide 8
Say "Great question, I'll come to that shortly" and continue
Skip ahead to slide 8 straight away
Ask everyone to hold questions until the end

items.q: You are messaging a hiring manager you have never met on LinkedIn. Which opening is strongest?
o: "Hi Ahmed, I saw your team is hiring growth interns. I grew our student club's Instagram from 2k to 9k followers in six months. Could I have 10 minutes of your time?"
"Hi Ahmed, I'm a marketing student at Cairo University and I'm very interested in your growth team."
"Hi Ahmed, could you refer me to the growth internship?"
"Hello sir, I am a hardworking and passionate student looking for any opportunity."

items.q: A teammate on a shared project has missed two deadlines, and it is now delaying your part. What is your first move?
o: Talk to them privately, ask what is blocking them, and agree a smaller next deadline together
Tell your manager, with dates and the impact on your work
Quietly do their part yourself so the project stays on track
Mention it in the team group chat so everyone is aware

items.q: An email says: "We will move the launch to the 14th only if the supplier confirms the new packaging by Thursday. Otherwise we keep the 10th and launch with the current packaging." The supplier does not confirm by Thursday. What happens?
o: The launch stays on the 10th with the current packaging
The launch moves to the 14th with the current packaging
The launch stays on the 10th with the new packaging
The launch is postponed until the supplier confirms

items.q: Last week an online store had 2,400 visitors and 60 orders. This week visitors went up by 25% and the conversion rate (orders divided by visitors) stayed the same. How many orders did the store get this week?
A product costs EGP 400 to make and sells for EGP 650. Delivery costs EGP 50 per order. What is the profit as a percentage of the selling price? Round to the nearest whole number.
Monthly sales fell by 30%. The data shows website visitors and the number of orders stayed about the same. What is the most likely explanation?
o: Customers are spending less per order, for example because of discounts or cheaper products
Demand dropped because of the season
Fewer people visited the website
The checkout page stopped working

items.q: Your to-do list: (A) fix an error for a major client, due 3 pm today; (B) the weekly report your manager reads on Monday; (C) a colleague asked for 30 minutes of help today; (D) tidy your inbox. Which order is best?
o: A, C, B, D
A, B, C, D
C, A, B, D
B, A, C, D

items.q: All interns at Company X speak English. Mona speaks English. Which statement must be true?
o: Mona may or may not be an intern at Company X
Mona is an intern at Company X
Mona is not an intern at Company X
Everyone who speaks English works at Company X

items.q: Your manager says "make the pitch deck better" before tomorrow's investor meeting. What do you do first?
o: Ask who will be in the room and what decision the meeting needs to reach
Ask a colleague which slides feel weakest, then fix those
Redesign the slides so they look more modern
Add as much supporting data as possible to every slide

items.q: In your first week, you notice a team process that seems slow and inefficient. What do you do?
o: Learn why it is done that way, then suggest an improvement with a small example
Suggest a better way in the next team meeting
Wait a few months until you understand the company before saying anything
Start doing it your own way without telling anyone

items.q: You realise a number you gave your manager yesterday was wrong, and it has already gone to a client. What do you do?
o: Tell your manager right away with the correct number and a draft correction for the client
Recheck all your other numbers first, then tell your manager tomorrow
Correct it in next month's report
Leave it, since the difference is small

items.q: Your manager says your work is good but you take too long. What is your best response?
o: Ask which tasks took too long and what time is reasonable, then check in again after two weeks
Work extra hours so you finish faster
Explain that you take time because you care about quality
Carry on as before, since the quality is good

items.q: You are working remotely and finish your tasks early on Thursday afternoon. What do you do?
o: Tell your manager you are done and suggest one or two useful things you could pick up
Start a project you think would help, and tell your manager about it on Sunday
Wait until someone gives you a new task
Log off early, since the work is done

items.q: A friend who works at a competitor asks when your company is launching its new product. What do you do?
o: Say politely that you cannot share internal plans
Check with your manager whether it is OK to share
Give a vague hint without a date
Tell them, since it will be public soon anyway

items.q: In an interview you are asked: "What is your biggest weakness?" Which answer is strongest?
o: A real, specific weakness, plus what you are doing about it and an example of progress
A real, specific weakness, explained honestly
"I'm a perfectionist, so I sometimes work too hard."
"I don't really have any major weaknesses."

items.q: Order values are in cells B2 to B500. Which formula counts the orders above EGP 1,000?
You want an AI tool like ChatGPT or Claude to draft a cold email. Which prompt will give the best result?
o: "Write a 100-word cold email to the HR manager of a Cairo fintech, introducing me as a final-year business student who built a budgeting tool, asking for a 15-minute call. Friendly but professional."
"Write a professional cold email to an HR manager asking for an internship."
"Write a cold email."
"Make my email good."

items.q: An AI tool gives you a market size figure for Egypt with no source. You need it for a client slide. What do you do?
o: Find the figure in a credible source, such as an official report, and cite that source
Use it, clearly labelled as an AI estimate
Ask the AI for its source and use the figure if it names one
Use it as it is, since AI tools are usually right

items.q: Revenue was EGP 120,000 in January, EGP 90,000 in February and EGP 135,000 in March. By what percentage did revenue grow from February to March?
A client asks for a spreadsheet that includes your customers' names and phone numbers. They only need sales totals by city. What do you do?
o: Share a version with only the totals by city, with access limited to the client
Share the full file as view-only with the client's email address
Share the full file using "anyone with the link" so it is easy to open
Email the full file as an attachment

items.q: Prices are in cells C2 to C101, and a few cells are empty. Which formula gives the correct average price?
o: =AVERAGE(C2:C101)
=MEAN(C2:C101)

writing.prompt: A customer sends this message: "I ordered a dress 9 days ago, paid online, and still nothing. This is the third time I'm asking. I want a refund now." You have checked: the courier lost the parcel. You can offer either a replacement delivered within 2 days, or a full refund within 5 to 7 working days. Write your reply to the customer in 60 to 150 words, in English or Arabic.
rubric: Acknowledges the frustration and apologises sincerely
Takes ownership without blaming the customer or making excuses
Explains clearly what happened and offers both options
Gives concrete next steps and timelines
Professional, warm tone; clear, concise and correct language
